why: toast.js and basecoat.js mark the toaster and each toast they started; ui names each toast and its button for its handlers. A leaving toast disables its controls to drop focus, as the kit requires.

known.why: toast.js blurs a toast's focused element when it closes it. surf has no way to ask for a blur (Autofocus asks for an element), so on a hotty host the keyboard stays on the hidden Dismiss button until the toast leaves and the host drops it with the element: an API question for surf (a blur through Autofocus), raised with the batch.
